# content-negotiation

> HTTP Accept/Accept-Language header parsing with q-values, specificity ordering, and media-type negotiation.

Implements RFC 9110 content negotiation: parse Accept headers with q-values (quality), sort by specificity (exact > subtype wildcard > full wildcard, then q-value), and negotiate(acceptHeader, available[]) to find best match. Handles Accept-Language similarly. Respects q=0 (exclusions).

## API

```typescript
interface MediaType { type, subtype, quality, parameters? }

function parseAccept(header: string): MediaType[]
function parseAcceptLanguage(header: string): { lang, quality }[]
function negotiate(acceptHeader: string, available: string[]): string | null
```

## Install

```bash
npm install content-negotiation
```

## Limits

- No charset parameter matching (Accept only)
- No Accept-Encoding/Accept-Charset (extend as needed)
- MediaType.parameters parsed but not matched during negotiation

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
